A body shop mechanic became a multi-millionaire - and he said the money had nothing to do with it.

Kevin Trudeau met him at a seminar in 1979. Over breakfast, Kevin joked: 'When I have your money, I'll have your attitude too.' The man stopped him: 'No. The attitude gets you the money.'

He meant it as instruction, not comfort. Walk into a room like you already own it. Feel like a millionaire while you're behind on rent. The feeling comes first, every time.

Most people wait for the bank account to change before they act differently. That's the mentality of someone who stays stuck.

What would you do differently today if the money was already on its way?

#kevintrudeau #richmindset #moneymindset #wealthhabits #selfimage #successmindset

He didn't know the first thing about the caviar business - and started it anyway.

Kevin Trudeau says the second excuse that keeps people stuck is 'I don't know how.' Successful people never say it. They say 'I'll figure it out as I go,' because they trust the how will show up once they commit.

Confidence comes before competence, not after. Wait for the full plan and you wait forever - everyone successful started without one.

The strategy, the technique, the method - they all arrive after you move, never before.

What opportunity are you still waiting to 'know how' before you take?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #successhabits #entrepreneur #richmindset #moneymindset

Four words separate the broke from the rich - and most people say the wrong ones every day.

Kevin Trudeau points out that 'I can't afford that' is a death sentence for your bank account: it's a statement your own mind works overtime to keep true. Rich people never say it.

Instead, they say 'not right now' or 'that's a little out of my budget at the present time.' Same situation, completely different signal.

One phrase locks the door. The other leaves it open for the money to come later.

Which one did you say today?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #richmindset #wealthhabits #selfimage #abundance

One tiny notch on autopilot put Kevin Trudeau's plane 500 miles off course - and that's exactly how most people lose years of their life.

He asked his pilots what would happen if they nudged the dial just slightly off target. 'You're going to be 500 miles over there,' they told him. The plane barely seemed to move. The destination changed completely.

Struggling people ignore the small shifts - a phrase, a belief, a daily habit - because they look too tiny to matter. Successful people obsess over exactly those details.

A one-degree change today becomes a completely different life years from now.

What small shift have you been putting off?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #richmindset #moneymindset #successhabits #wealthhabits

Kevin Trudeau replaced his own employee at the computer - same ads, same two weeks - and the results jumped overnight.

Nothing changed except who was in the chair. 'That's like magic,' people said. It wasn't magic, it was attitude. A book called Karmic Management studied two people doing the identical activity: one got results, one didn't.

Manifesting without action is fantasy. But action without the right attitude produces nothing either.

Kevin's real point: you don't have a money problem. You have an attitude problem. Fix your thinking, and the strategy finds you.

Where is your attitude actually at today?
